subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a shared provider-backed live-catalog contract for configured `/v1/models` endpoints, and what policy should govern caching, model visibility, and configured allowlists?
rationale: The remaining work chooses durable product and compatibility policy across providers, not a narrow repair with an already-defined expected behavior.

options.title: Sponsor the canonical live-catalog design
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/74481 as the canonical design and implementation tracker, including explicit cache, credential, allowlist, and offline semantics.

options.title: Keep static catalogs as the supported baseline
options.body: Retain current catalog behavior and document provider-specific configuration or plugin-based workarounds rather than adding runtime discovery.

options.title: Scope to a provider-owned OpenRouter path first
options.body: Approve a narrow OpenRouter implementation only after defining how it preserves existing selection and safety policies without creating a second generic catalog abstraction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the canonical live-catalog design
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/74481 as the canonical design and implementation tracker, including explicit cache, credential, allowlist, and offline semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned author of the detailed architecture proposal and the best available routing contact in the supplied evidence.
